segments.text: "Yuu-chan, it would be so nice if you could follow Saeka-san's example…"
4th year university student
Height: Short
Figure: Flat but doesn't mind
Appearance: Nervous, can't leave her alone
Favorite Things: Star gazing, being relied on
Hobby / Skill: Collecting idol goods, flexible body

Tamaki's a college student who moved to Ayakita to work as a student teacher. Although having the appearance of a kid, she tries to act like an adult towards the girls, but things don't turn out the way she expects it to. At her core, she's optimistic, positive, and somewhat clumsy.
A graduate from Ayanan high school and former student council president before Natsuki and Mio, she worries about whether or not she's seen as a kid but tries to ignore that fact.
Tamaki and Yuuno are both cousins and were always playing together during their childhood. From that time, she has been a fan of idols and movie actors to where she's collected idol merchandise.
She tries to watch over Yuuno, who can cause her trouble at times, but in reality, Tamaki is the one who's being watched over instead.
She was in the astronomy club in high school and loves watching stars even now.
Translated from Official Site
お子様風教育実習生。
絢北に教育実習生として赴任してきた大学生で、みんなに対して年上っぽく振る舞おうとするけれど、なかなか上手くいかなかったり。
基本は脳天気なポジティブドジ。
出身は絢崎南高校で、なつきや美緒とは生徒会のＯＢ会つながりで顔見知り。
年齢の割に子供っぽく見られがちなことを気にしているけれど、気合いでスルー。
遊乃とは従姉妹同士で、子供の頃はよく一緒に遊んであげていた。
その頃からアイドルや映画俳優が好きで、今でもアイドルのグッズを集めていたりする。
遊乃に苦労をかけられるというところで共感できるおかげか、相談に乗ってあげているつもりだけれど、実際は逆に面倒を看られている感じ……？
高校生の頃は天文部員で、今でも星を見たりするのが好き。
绚崎南高中的毕业生，参加过夏树和美绪学生会的校友会。年龄看起来很小。是游乃的表姐。
"Goodness… Yuuno, you shouldn't cause Tamaki-sensei so much trouble, though I can understand you not wanting to leave her alone."
Height: Average
Figure: Surprisingly slender
Appearance: Crisp, serious
Favorite Things: Reading, tidied room and belongings, grandmother's pickled vegetables
Hobby / Skill: Gardening, Takatsuki's fighting arts of a ninja acquired from grandmother
Part of the public morals committee and gardening club, Saeka is seen as strict and cold because of her serious demeanor. She's a normal, kind girl but has trouble dealing with people.

She can get somewhat jealous when seeing others get along but is happy when she gets the chance to spend time with another person... Because of that, she admires Yuuno's cheerfulness and Tamaki's friendliness.

Her home is of ninja lineage, her grandmother being a ninja herself. Due to being trained vigorously from a young age, Saeka is able to move her body with ease. She doesn't think too much of that ability, but others find that appealing.
She lives in the dorms since her home is far away from school and has roomed with Yuuno since 1st year of high school.
Translated from Official Site
風紀委員。園芸部にも所属している。
生真面目な立ち振る舞いのせいで、周囲からは厳格で冷徹なように見られがちだけれど、人付き合いが苦手なだけで、普通の優しい女の子。
なんだか羨ましかったりもするし、２人と一緒に過ごすだけで嬉しかったりもするし……という理由で、遊乃の快活さや珠季の人懐っこさに憧れていたりする。
実家が忍者の家系で、祖母がくのいち。
子供の頃からいろいろと修行をやらされていたおかげで、身体を動かすことは得意。
そのことについて、本人はあまり気にしていない。周りからはネタだと思われている。
実家が遠いため寮生活を送っている。１年生の頃から遊乃とは同室。
风纪委员，普通的温柔型的女孩子，很不擅长与人交往。离家很远，所以住在宿舍里，和游乃是室友。
"Tama-chan, you should always look at me more! Don't you think so too, Sae-chan?"
Height: Tall
Figure: Healthy, in-shape
Appearance: Sparkly, eye catching
Favorite Things: Standing out, being pampered
Hobby / Skill: Playing the drums, rhythm games, crane games from arcades

Yuuno is a new, upcoming idol who works hard every day to become a praiseworthy idol while Tamaki (cousin) and Saeka (dorm roommate) both watch over her. She's an energetic girl who'll take a stab at anything.
She has faith beyond that of a normal friend towards Saeka who looks after her. They're complete opposites of each other, but both get along strangely enough.
Yuuno's desire from when she was a kid… of wanting to have Tamaki to always look at her… has made her want to be an idol.
Her self-introduction catch phrase isn't popular with everyone, which has been her latest concern, though she herself thinks it's pretty cool~.
Translated from Official Site
売り出し中の新人アイドル。
従姉妹である珠季や、寮で同室の紗恵香に世話を焼いてもらいつつ、立派なアイドルになるために日々努力中。
とりあえずやってみる系な元気ガール。
なんだかんだで面倒を看てくれる紗恵香のことは普通の友達以上に信頼していて、自分とは全然違うタイプだと思うけど、それでも気が合う不思議。
珠季には自分のことをずっと見ていて欲しくて……という子供の頃の思いが、アイドルを目指したきっかけ。
自己紹介のフレーズがみんなにウケてないのが、最近の悩み。
自分では気に入ってるんだけどな～。
新人偶像，被表姐珠季和同宿舍的纱惠香照顾着。不知为何对纱惠香有了朋友以上的信赖感。
"Ayame-chan… always be by my side. Promise me…"
Height: Short
Figure: Fair
Appearance: Mature
Hobbies: Reading, watching movies, doing things alone in her room

Slightly reserved and shy around people, Hina met Ayame after transferring middle schools in her 3rd year. Thanks to her, she was able to fit in with everyone in class. They even shared the same classes together.

Because of her genuine adoration of Ayame's cheerfulness and sociability, Hina has been gradually holding special feelings towards her -- even now. Lately, her shyness has lessened a bit while hanging out with her and the other girls to the point where she can be assertive to Ayame.
She can be lost and worried at times, but her love for Ayame grows by the day. It would mean the world to her if she could answer Hina's feelings.
Featured in Drama CD Vol. 1 "Koigokoro Furenzu" (Love Friends)
Translated from Official Site
ちょっと引っ込み思案で、人見知り気味。
中学３年の時、転校してきた学校で彩愛と出会い、彼女のおかげでクラスに馴染めるようになった。
高校でも彩愛とは同じクラス。
自分にない明るさや社交性は、純粋な憧れの対象でもあったところから、次第に、彩愛に対して特別な感情を抱いていくようになり、今に至る。
彩愛や他のみんなと過ごしているうちに、最近ではちょっとだけ人見知りも和らいできた様子。
むしろ彩愛に対しては、だんだんと積極的になっているぐらい。
まだまだ戸惑うことや、不安になることもあるけれど、彩愛のことを好きな気持ちは日に日に大きくなっていて、彩愛もそれに応えてくれるという今の関係があれば、何があっても全然平気。
稍稍有些不擅言谈，对初中时候开始主动和阳奈接触的，有着开朗性格的彩爱，有着特别的感情。
"If it's for your sake, Hina, I'll do whatever I can! I mean it!"
Height: Average
Figure: So-so
Appearance: Boisterous
Hobbies: Window shopping for clothes and jewelry (If I can afford it, I'll buy!)
Energetic, lively, and popular, Ayame is the life of the party with many thoughts of Hina in mind. Although optimistic and resilient, she has her share of worries and can be relatively lonely.
Her grades slip since she's always looking at Hina. Thanks to this, Ayame considers herself lucky to receive her tutelage. Naturally, she'll do her best whenever Hina cheers her on.
She's into fashion but has been more interested in tampering with Hina's hair, choosing her clothes, and things of that nature. As long as she's happy, so too is Ayame.
Featured in Drama CD Vol. 1 "Koigokoro Furenzu" (Love Friends)
Translated from Official Site
元気で明るく友達も多く、ついでに陽奈のことで頭が一杯なムードメーカー的存在。
楽天的だけど悩まないことはない。でも立ち直りは早い。割と寂しがりや。
いつも陽奈のことばかり見ているせいで成績が下降気味だけど、おかげで陽奈に勉強見てもらえるからラッキー、ぐらいに考えていたり。
勿論、陽奈に応援されたらがんばっちゃう。
おしゃれのことは、いろいろ気にする方だけれど、最近は自分より陽奈の髪型をいじったり、服を選んであげたりするのが楽しみ。
陽奈がかわいいと、自分も嬉しいわけで。
开朗活泼的乐天派，但是其实内心非常寂寞。虽然内心认为自己是阳奈的最好的朋友，实际上只是没有自觉而已。
"I'm happy that I like Mai… but it's not because of her, okay...?"
Height: Average
Figure: Slender
Appearance: Lovely
Special Skills: Feigning friendliness, drawing art

Mai's older sister. Graceful as ever and popular with the boys, in reality, however, she's lazy and sees the world around her as bothersome. Her adoration from other girls has gone up of late, but she has no eyes for anyone else except for Mai.

After knowing that her sister will support her whatever the circumstances may be, Mayu has gotten more confident about being her true self. Despite trying to thank Mai for that, she still can't be honest with herself yet…

Since she pushes her tedious, everyday necessities on Mai (doesn't mind it at all), Mayu is pretty bad at the basics of domestic chores but has been helping Mai out lately and has even reached a point where she can cook on her own, though her room is a mess. Mayu is also currently a member of the art club.
Featured in Drama CD Vol. 2 "bitter honey"
Translated from Official Site
真衣の姉。表向きは相変わらずおしとやかで男子にもてるけれど、その本性は、面倒くさがりでものぐさ。
ここのところ女子からも慕われることが増えてきた。
とはいえ、真衣以外は眼中にない。
真衣が支えてくれているという気持ちがはっきりしてからは、素の自分に対しても自信を持てるようになってきていたり。
その分を、真衣に感謝しようとはするけれど、まだまだ素直じゃない時も……。
身の回りの面倒なことは真衣に押しつけている（真衣が自発的にやる）ので、家事全般その他諸々は苦手だけれど、最近は真衣を手伝って、自分でお弁当を作るようになったり。でも部屋は片付かない。
美術部。
真衣的姐姐，举止端庄，很受男生欢迎。虽然本性有些懒散。表面上对真衣十分严厉，实际上是依靠着真衣。
"Ah shucks~, I get all happy when Mayu's nice~. Oh, I think that's how I feel whenever I think about her!"
Height: Tall
Figure: Supple
Appearance: Cool
Special Skill: Sports in general (specifically running types)
Mayu's younger sister. Talented in sports and always popular with the ladies, because she knows in her heart that the one she likes the most is Mayu, Mai doesn't worry about what other people think.

Despite looking after her older sister, she gets really excited sometimes over their closeness so much that Mayu ends up scolding her. Mai likes that side of her too and even thinks about how much more she can pamper her. Internally, she's a bit drawn to the feminity of girls.

One of her specialties is cooking since she takes care of the house chores and cooking in place of Mayu. Recently, she went shopping with Mayu and became very interested in pumps that she usually doesn't wear, but she definitely wouldn't wear those under normal circumstances, though. Mai is currently in the track-and-field club.
Featured in Drama CD Vol. 2 "bitter honey"
Translated from Official Site
真優の妹。スポーツ万能で相変わらず女子から人気。
でも、一番好きな相手が真優だと自信を持って言えるようになったので、周囲からの反応はあまり気にしなくなった。
変わらず真優の世話を焼きつつも、今までよりも縮まった２人の距離感が嬉しくて、ついついにやけてしまうのを真優に注意される。そのやり取りも嬉しかったりする。
真優にもうちょっと甘えていってもいいのかな～、なんて思ってもいたり。
内面的には女の子らしさにちょっと惹かれていたりもする。
真優の代わりに家事をやったり、自分で弁当を作ったりするので、料理は得意。
最近、真優と一緒に買いに行った普段履かないようなパンプスが、一番のお気に入り。
でも本当に普段は履かない。
陸上部。
真优的妹妹，运动万能的帅气型，虽然自己很受女孩子欢迎，但是内心很憧憬真优端庄的样子。经常代替真优做事。
"I hate it when Ibu acts like a perv. But… I do kind of like that side of her in a way…"
Height: Short
Figure: Chagrin
Appearance: Tiny yet cute
Favorite Things: Any sweet candy, any doll given by Ibuki

The only daughter of the Kugayama household and the so-called upper class girl, Alice acts like a total tsundere specifically to Ibuki, but likes her nonetheless. She's completely frank with her friends and is quite diligent.

Looking up to Ibuki who's watched over her since she was a kid, Alice has grown to love her, wanting to spoil her when given the chance but doesn't know how to be honest with herself. At times she can be in a pouty mood, to which Ibuki uses this as an opportunity to mess with her.

Her feelings of wanting to be with the one she loves is true indeed, but there's absolutely no way she herself would reveal something so embarrassing. Alice has called Ibuki as "Ibu," a nickname she gave her from when she was a child.
Featured in Drama CD Vol. 3 "Motto, Zutto, Gyutto" (lit. Hug me, longer, forever)
Translated from Official Site
玖雅山家の一人娘。いわゆるいいとこのお嬢様。
伊吹に対しては特にツンデレをこじらせてはいるけれど、でもちゃんと好き。
周りの友達ともすっかり打ち解けた感じ。結構がんばり屋さん。
子供の頃から面倒を看てくれていた伊吹のことを、ホントは慕っていて、大好きだし、たくさん甘えたいけれど、まだまだ素直になりきれないお年頃。
プンスコしつつ、結局伊吹に弄ばれていたり。
それでも、好きな相手に触れたいという伊吹の気持ちに対しては、それなりに共感できるようになってきた。でも恥ずかしいので絶対に言わない。
子供の頃からのあだ名で、伊吹のことを"イブ"と呼ぶ。
玖雅山家的大小姐。虽然是大小姐其实是个好孩子，只是因为傲娇而不被他人理解。对从小照顾自己的伊吹当成是真正的姐姐。
"I love you so much, Alice. So that means it's perfectly legal to squeeze and kiss you all over, huh!"
Height: Tall
Figure: Plump
Appearance: Fluffy Onee-san
Hobbies: Messing with Alice, being messed with by Alice, collecting cute things
Alice's childhood friend who lives and works as a maid in the Kugayama household. Alice always finds her annoying, but Ibuki sees that as her way of showing love.
Everyone knows she's quite polished in the art of perversion, although she doesn't consider it like that. She likes Alice so much that Ibuki's every move is centered around her.

She's always smiling, able to complete anything at will but can't handle scary things in general, like ghost stories, rollercoasters, and thunder. Another nickname she calls Alice by besides Milady is "Awe-chan," which she came up with when they were young. Alice would shy away upon hearing that name.
Featured in Drama CD Vol. 3 "Motto, Zutto, Gyutto" (lit. Hug me, longer, forever)
Translated from Official Site
アリスの幼なじみで、玖雅山家で働く住み込みメイド（バイト）。
アリスからはいつもうざがられてばかりいるけれど、端々から滲み出る愛情を敏感に感じ取って勝手に満足している。
変態性に磨きがかかったことについては周囲からの定評があるものの、しかし実は変態ではないというのが本人の談。
アリスのことが好きすぎて、伊吹の持つ全ての価値観はアリスを基準に回っている。
普段はいつもにこにこしていて、何事もそつなくこなすけど、怪談や絶叫マシン、雷など、怖いもの全般が苦手。
普段はアリスのことをお嬢様と呼ぶほか、子供の頃からのあだ名で"あーちゃん"と呼ぶこともある。アリスは恥ずかしがる。
爱丽丝的青梅竹马，从小时候开始就照顾着她。虽然看起来比较腹黑，实际上却是对恐怖的东西没有办法的性格。
"Hehe. Waka-chan, you're so cute. Even when you get a bit too lively, you're still cute~."
Height: Average
Figure: Fairly good
Appearance: Tense
Hobby/Skill: Sewing, knitting, collecting cute, small things
Although normally cheerful and calm, Ayumi has such a serious and caring personality that she can't help herself from taking an obedient role when Waka comes into the picture.

Waka has been tagging along with her since they met in middle school. Ayumi doesn't hate the fun she has or the clamor she makes, but is rather grateful to Waka that she's let her discover new sides of herself that she had never known about.
Compelled by Waka who has thrown her feelings straight at Ayumi, they've reached a point where they can share in each other's feelings.
Ayumi's room is held captive by dolls she made herself. She's currently in the handicrafts club.
Featured in Drama CD Vol. 4 "Himitsu Rireishon" (lit. Secret Relationship)
Translated from Official Site
普段は朗らかで落ち着いているけれど、羽佳に絡まれるとついつい鋭く突っ込まずにはいられない、生真面目で面倒見のいい性格。
中学生の頃に羽佳と出会って、以来なんだかんだと付きまとわれている。
羽佳の楽しさや騒がしさは嫌いではないし、むしろ自分でも知らなかった自身の新しい一面を見つけさせてくれることには、感謝しているぐらい。
自分の気持ちをまっすぐに投げかけてくれる羽佳に背中を押され、２人でその気持ちに向き合っていけるようになる。
自室は自分で作ったぬいぐるみに占領されている。
手芸部員。
平常是个开朗冷静的女孩子，在羽佳面前才会显露自己的真面目。从初中和羽佳相遇以来，慢慢对羽佳诞生了好感。
"Ayumi-senpa~i! I love you so muchhh! Ayuumi-senpa~~~i!!!"
Height: Short
Figure: TBD
Appearance: Kerfuffle
Favorite Things: Ayumi, meat, and cute, small things Ayumi gives her (despite dropping them often)
A simplistic dork of a girl whom people find loving yet irritating at the same time, even though she has lots of friends.
Ayumi has treated her cordially from the time they met in middle school, and ever since then, Waka has been obsessed to where she'll chase her around.

Her love for Ayumi has expanded within the time they've spent together to such a degree that she follows schematics made in her heart, underlining a single thought: "The one I like the most" = "The one I'm meant to be with." She will call out to her lovingly every day, even if Ayumi gets tired of it.
She's in the handicrafts club for now only because Ayumi's in there. Luckily, everything in the club is intact and hasn't been destroyed yet, given Waka's personality.
Featured in Drama CD Vol. 4 "Himitsu Rireishon" (lit. Secret Relationship)
Translated from Official Site
天真爛漫なアホよい子。
周囲からは小動物的にかわいがられ、それと同じくらい鬱陶しがられてもいる。
交友関係は広く、友達も多い。
中学生の頃に歩実と出会い、色々と親身になってくれた歩実のことをすっかり気に入ってしまって、以来彼女を追いかけ回している。
歩実が好きだという気持ちは一緒の時間を過ごす内にどんどん膨れ上がっていき、『一番好き』＝『恋人同士の好き』、という自分の中の図式に則って、今日も歩実にラブコールを送る。歩実がお腹いっぱいでも伝え続ける毎日。
一応手芸部員だけど、歩実がいるから入部したというだけなので、手芸的なことは何一つ壊滅的にできない。
高中一年生。天真烂漫带一点笨蛋的性格，朋友很多。初中遇到步实的时候就对步实有好感，随着时间，这种感觉越来越强烈。
"Seira, show me some more of that shyness of yours. I'll do the same for you. Sound good…?"
Height: Tall
Figure: Reasonable
Appearance: Frank
Special Skills: Cramming overnight before tests, taming animals, sports in general (specifically ball game ones)
Cheerful, sociable, and having lots of friends, Hare is the student council president. Seen as candid and reliable, she's good at dealing with things and is at the ready when called on.

Although attracted by Seira, who progresses forward and faces things head on, Hare does worry about her, but thanks to the time she's spent with Seira, they both were able to throw their feelings at each other, making their true intentions heard.
Hare does the big jobs of the student council (and lets Seira handle the minor stuff).
Featured in Drama CD Vol. 5 "Zawameki, Tokimeki, Yappa Suki" (lit. Commotion, Throbbing, Love Nevertheless)
Translated from Official Site
明るくて人当たりもよくて友達も多い、生徒会会長。
さばさばしていて、頼り甲斐があるように見られがちだけど、どちらかというと要領がいい感じで、少し斜に構えているところもある。
何事にも全力で立ち向かい前に進んでいく星良の姿勢に惹かれたり、いろいろ悩んだりもしていたけれど、星良と過ごした時間のおかげで、今では当たり前に、本音や好きの気持ちをぶつけ合えるようになった。
生徒会の業務は、目立つところだけちゃんとやって後は割と適当。
（細かいところは星良に任せっぱなし）
学生会长，性格开朗，在很多方面被人依赖着。被星良的什么事情都全力向前的性格所吸引。
"Hare, you're always, always showing off. Why… can't you just do that to only me?"
Height: Average
Figure: Distinguished
Appearance: Sparkling
Special Skills?: Decorating small things with peace signs, memorization, simple stuff involving mental arithmetic, making a smile at work

Hardworker, confident, and somewhat of an airhead, Seira is the student council vice president, who is often seen as sociable and tries to act that way, though she's nervous around strangers. She doesn't want to accept that truth, however.

She always sees Hare as her rival but losses to her in the slimmest of margins. She does, nonetheless, maintain her straightforwardness of saying what she wants. Seeing Hare flustered gives her a slight sense of superiority.
She's at peace of mind when Hare accepts her challenges, no matter what it is. Seira is in charge of the minor details left over by Hare during student council sessions.
Featured in Drama CD Vol. 5 "Zawameki, Tokimeki, Yappa Suki" (lit. Commotion, Throbbing, Love Nevertheless)
Translated from Official Site
努力家で自信家でちょっとドジな、生徒会副会長。
社交性があるように見られがちで、自分でもそのように振る舞うけれど、根は割とコミュ障気味。でも自分では認めたくない。
相変わらず晴のことはライバル視していたり僅差で負けたりもするけれど、好意を伝える時のまっすぐさは負けてない。
それでドギマギする晴の姿を見るのは、ちょっと優越感。
どれだけ突っかかっていっても受け止めてくれる晴の対応には、一番安心できる。
生徒会では晴のやり残した細かい業務担当。
学生会副会长，自一年级开学以来就把晴视为对手，对晴发起了各种的挑战。在学生会里帮助晴做细小的杂物。

Height: Short

Appearance: Lazy
Favorite Things: Napping while laying head on Mio's lap, games (mainly smartphone apps), fish sausage
Natsuki, who is lazy and finds most things bothersome, is Mio's childhood friend. She doesn't have the energy to do basic tasks but is quick-witted when it comes to planning out fun stuff to do.

Her relationship with Mio, who she relies on, hasn't changed so much, even after confirming each other's feelings, but being together with her has made her happy more than ever. She'll go at her own leisurely pace while having those kinds of thoughts in mind.
Since her mom is a fashion magazine editor, Natsuki will sometimes work as a part-time amateur model in there (is actually made to), though she doesn't have the self-awareness for the job.

Figure: Fair
Appearance: Fluffy
Favorite Things: Natsuki's frizzy hair, spicy food (Natsuki would die if she ate that)

Even if agitated by others, Mio, Natsuki's childhood friend, will always maintain her smile with a calm, gentle demeanor. She goes at her own pace and is overprotective of Natsuki, though some might see this as a curse than a blessing.

Although she would like Natsuki to be a little bit more responsible, Mio can't stop herself from wanting to help her out. After having the confidence of realizing each other's feelings, the two have been pretty much inseparable.
It kind of bothers Mio when she's seen as someone older due to her plain clothes, and she has some worry about her weight as well.
